training_state.interpretation: both stages are schedule-truncated, not converged

root_causes.issue: semantic certificate mask was overwritten by the top-k Pareto shortlist before gate metrics
valid-index fallback was undercounted and stop/yield was incorrectly treated as inherently non-coercive
only about 27.25% of scenes contain any NCF proposal
rule-protected relations could be diluted by the learned priority score
the UCB uncertainty target omitted same-root recovery and minimum safe burden errors
inactive/frozen losses diluted transport/planner checkpoint selection
all recorded checkpoints were still improving when scheduled training ended

implemented_changes: explicit least-predicted-coercion fallback and honest fallback accounting
versioned certificate/fallback metric semantics with stale-result rejection
fresh v16_8_2 causal protocol and staged reeval/mechanism/probe/full launchers

next_decision.step_0: reevaluate existing v16.8.1 checkpoints under v16.8.2 semantics
next_decision.step_1: if infeasible, retrain transport/planner with 24/16 epoch defaults and corrected objectives
next_decision.step_2: if AnyNCFSceneRate remains below 0.35 or PBTR/fallback dominate, rebuild fresh BCTE labels/cache
next_decision.step_3: run Waymax probe/full only after pass=true and calibration_feasible=true
next_decision.do_not: do not solve the failure by only increasing the BCOT budget or lowering gate thresholds
